Requests go directly from this device to Google Gemini using your own API key.

• Only what you select or allow is sent: the selected area, your question and any pages you approve.
• On the free tier, Google may use prompts and images to improve its products, and people may review them. Do not send personal or confidential material.
• Answers can be wrong. Check important results.

Get a free key in Google AI Studio

Your key is stored only in this app\'s private storage on this device. It is never shared, exported or backed up. On the free tier Google may use what you send to improve its products; only what you select or allow is sent.

In Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials, open your key:
1. Application restrictions → Android apps → Add: the package name and SHA-1 fingerprint below.
2. API restrictions → Restrict key → Generative Language API.
Then a copied key will not work in other apps.
